name: ScummVM RNC method-2 reference
license_evidence: File headers in common/compression/rnc_deco.cpp and .h; COPYING contains GPL version 3; COPYRIGHT retained.
role: Independent research/extraction reference, isolated from future native game runtime.
compatibility_glue: Original endian/type shim generated by tools/build_rnc_reference.py; original re/reference_scripts/rnc_reference_main.cpp subclasses decoder only for pointer/CRC observation.
dependencies: Clang clang++ with compiler-rt AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer
execution_interface: rnc-reference INPUT.rnc; stdout is binary decoded data only on success; stderr is JSON metadata except sanitizer/OS failure diagnostics.
limitations: Upstream unpackM2 has unchecked memory accesses. Exact allocations and mandatory ASan/UBSan cause fail-stop on invalid access rather than implementing a hardened decoder.
Accepts only exact header+packed extent and requires final source/destination pointers to match declared sizes.
Reference tool license does not grant rights to ROM inputs or decoded resources.
compiler_selection: Clang22.1.7 has installed compiler-rt; GCC16.1.1 sanitizer link failed because system libasan/libubsan runtimes are absent.
